{{Quote|Set course for the Denarii Nova! I have a plan to make use of the remaining power we have!|Naga Sadow|<ref name="TFotSE5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref>}}
The '''Denarii Nova''' was the name given to a [[Binary star/Legends|pair]] of [[Star/Legends|stars]] located in the [[Denarii system]],<ref name="TEA" /> and later in the [[Denarii Nebula/Legends|Denarii Nebula]],<ref name="Lightsabers" /><ref name="TERC" /> of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was known to be far removed from the [[Black Hole of Quintas/Legends|Black Hole of Quintas]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

The smaller star of the Denarii Nova fed on [[Gas/Legends|gases]] stolen from the larger one.<ref name="DLotS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Force is in all things, from the smallest pebble to the largest star. This is just a glimmer of how Naga Sadow reached out to the stars and delivered a mortal wound five thousand years ago.''"<br />"''Could you make the sun explode?''"<br />"''I don't know. And I don't believe I ever want to try.|[[Brakiss]] and [[Zekk]]|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
[[File:Denarii_supernova.png|thumb|left|220px|The explosion created by Naga Sadow]]
At the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]<ref name="TFotSE5" /> in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="pawns">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] flew his damaged [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']], between the [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]] of the Denarii Nova to escape the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Koros fleet|forces]] that pursued him. The [[Sith sorcerer]] [[Battle at the Denarii Nova|used]] his [[Sith sorcery/Legends|powers]] to [[Supernova (Sith magic)|manipulate]] the [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]] of the Denarii Nova, thus creating an explosion that destroyed the Republic [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in his wake.<ref name="DLotS1" />

This cataclysmic event resulted in the destruction of the entire [[Denarii system]],<ref name="DLotS1" /> which created a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] of highly ionized [[Gas/Legends|gases]] known as the [[Denarii Nebula/Legends|Denarii Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the fanatical [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Ishin-Il-Raz]] committed suicide by plunging his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Emperor's Disciple]]'', into the [[Fire/Legends|firestorm]] of the Denarii Nova, killing himself and his entire crew.<ref name="Who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref>

During the [[Second Imperium]] [[Second Imperium Crisis|crisis]] in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> following a [[Raid on Coruscant (Second Imperium Crisis)|raid]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="TLO">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref> the [[Shadow Academy]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] found a new hiding place near the dying [[Star/Legends|stars]] of the Denarii Nova,<ref name="Lightsabers" /> within the Denarii Nebula.<ref name="TERC" />
